subject: Novus Therapeutics — onsite agenda spine, session owners, and pre-session reading kit
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire.park@novusrx.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@novusrx.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Novus workshop — draft agenda and pre-read ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — delighted to be moving this to a confirmed week. Our leadership team requested a single, concise agenda spine plus a pre-session reading kit they can browse the week before.

Attached is a very rough draft agenda (Novus_Workshop_Draft_Agenda_v1.xlsx). High level asks:
- Can Redwood propose a final "agenda spine" that structures the day into 90/60/30 min blocks and identifies session leads?
- We want a single pre-session packet (one PDF + slide links) no later than 7 calendar days before arrival.
- Any constraints on format (PDF + slide link) or recommended order for pre-reads?

If possible can you send an initial agenda spine and recommended session owners by EOD next Wednesday (May 26)? Our travel team needs the finalized list for visa/arrival logistics.

Claire
Claire Park
Head of Strategic Programs | Novus Therapeutics
[attachment: Novus_Workshop_Draft_Agenda_v1.xlsx (excel)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@novusrx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus workshop — draft agenda and pre-read ask

Claire — thanks for the clear direction and the draft. We can absolutely do the agenda spine + consolidated pre-session packet. Plan below and immediate asks.

Plan (deliverables & owner):
- Agenda spine (single-page timeline with session titles + outcomes) — owner: Soojin Lee (will draft)
- Session owner matrix (who speaks to what, length, and backup) — owner: Marissa Cole (will collect speaker bios)
- Speaker packet (slide template, timing, AV notes, rehearsal slots) — owner: Mateo Alvarez (AV runbook)
- Consolidated pre-read (single PDF + links) — owner: Evelyn Hart (editor and publisher)

Timing: I will send the first-pass agenda spine by COB Wednesday May 26 as requested. Marissa will circulate a session-owner template that we ask your internal SMEs to fill by Monday May 24 to keep to the 7-day pre-read deadline.

Format guidance for pre-reads:
- One PDF "Pre-Session Kit" assembled by Evelyn containing: executive 1-pager, topline metrics, and any short 1–2 page briefs.
- Slides: host as individual slide links (Google Slides or PDFs) behind the kit. We avoid embedding many full decks in the main PDF to keep file size small for leadership.

Quick asks for Novus team now:
1) Who are the confirmed session leads (names + titles) — please provide by Mon May 24.
2) Any restrictions on attendee headshots or titles (we'll create name badges) — let us know.

I attached our speaker packet template to speed handoffs.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Senior Program Manager, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_Speaker_Packet_Template_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus workshop — draft agenda and pre-read ask

All — attaching a session_owner_matrix.csv with my proposed mapping. A few notes inline here:

- Proposed session titles: Opening context (So0jin), Product deep-dive (Marissa), Ops & Security (Evelyn), Strategy breakout (Novus SME), Wrap + next steps (Soojin).
- Slide length guidance per session: 10–12 slides for 60-minute blocks, 4–6 slides for 30-minute lightning sessions.
- AV/rehearsal: Mateo, can you confirm two 30-minute rehearsal windows on the day before for the key speakers? We should also confirm whether Novus prefers 16:9 or 4:3 slides — Claire, any strict preference?

Internal note: asking Novus for session lead confirmations by end of day Tuesday May 25 to keep producer buffer.

Attachment: session_owner_matrix.csv (columns: session, proposed_owner, backup, slide_count_est, bio_needed)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead Customer Solutions Producer | Redwood Inference

- Novus prefers 16:9 slides.
- Confirmed session leads:
   * Opening context — Claire Park (Novus)
   * Product deep-dive — Daniel Ruiz (Novus)
   * Ops & Security — Novus IT (we'll share name by EOD)
   * Strategy breakout — Dr. Hannah Young (external advisor)
   * Wrap — Claire Park

I've attached our attendee/leadership list for badge printing. Procurement is looped for the travel policy question: what is the recommended latest travel arrival time for speakers from Redwood (we need flight ETA to set ground transport)? Also: will Redwood publish a short bio page per speaker in the pre-read?

Attachment: Novus_Leadership_List.pdf

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus workshop — draft agenda and pre-read ask

Claire / team — great, thanks for the confirmations. Final checklist and next steps below.

What Redwood will deliver (timelines):
- Final agenda spine (one-pager PDF) — owner Soojin — delivery: Mon May 31 EOD PT.
- Session owner matrix (completed) — Marissa — delivered Tue May 25 (attached earlier).
- Speaker packet + rehearsal slots (AV runbook) — Mateo — rehearsal windows scheduled: Tue July 6 14:00–14:30 and Tue July 6 15:00–15:30 local. Mateo will send calendar invites once you confirm speaker availability.
- Consolidated pre-session kit (PDF + slide links) — Evelyn — final publish: Tue July 11 09:00 local (7 days before onsite). Evelyn will add a one-line bio for each speaker in the kit.

Travel guidance for procurement:
- Recommended arrival for Redwood speakers: the evening before (arrive by 20:00 local) to allow for a quick AV walk-through and an optional dinner with the Novus team. If flights arrive later than 22:00 local we cannot guarantee on-site transport.

Deliverables links and assets:
- Shared folder (read-only for Novus): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cnovus-workshop
- Draft agenda spine (first pass): https://redwoodinference.app/meeting-assets/NOVUS-ENT-2027-07/deck

A few open items for Novus:
1) Please send the Ops & Security session lead name (we need contact for the runbook) — due Tue May 31.
2) Confirm speaker travel arrival windows for rehearsal invites — please reply-all with each speaker's ETA.
3) Approve the speaker bios being included in the pre-read (we will limit bios to 60–80 words each).

We'll follow up with calendar invites and a short producer call the week of June 7 to run through final logistics.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Senior Program Manager, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
